Title: Green Stripe Print Hand Block-Printed Toiletry Pouch Set (3-Piece)
Body (HTML):
Crisp green stripes wrap this pouch set for every small thing that needs a home — pencils and hair clips one day, brushes and perfume the next.

Block-printed on cotton with a green candy-stripe print and matching tasselled zip-pull, quilted with a plastic-lined interior that wipes clean, in three nested sizes — Small (L16 x W11 x H7cm), Medium (L21 x W12 x H11cm), and Large (L24 x W14 x H14cm).

A genuine four-in-one set: the large pouch works as a toiletry kit or packing cube for a suitcase, the medium as a travel organizer for creams and wipes, and the small as a hair-accessory pouch or coin purse — or hand all three to a toddler as a stationery and toy-sorting kit for crayons, blocks, and cars.

Hand block-printed in Jaipur, one motif pressed at a time — small variations in the print are the mark of genuine handwork, not a flaw. Dyed with azo-free, skin-safe colours. A set of 3, ready to gift.
